64	class _Percent0To100Validator(QValidator):
65	    """仅允许 0～100 的整数，禁止前导零（仅允许单独一个「0」表示零）；空串为 Intermediate。"""
66	
67	    def validate(self, input_str: str, pos: int):
68	        if input_str == "":
69	            return QValidator.State.Intermediate, input_str, pos
70	        if not input_str.isdigit():
71	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
72	        if len(input_str) > 1 and input_str.startswith("0"):
73	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
74	        if len(input_str) > 3:
75	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
76	        v = int(input_str)
77	        if v > 100:
78	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
79	        return QValidator.State.Acceptable, input_str, pos

203	    @staticmethod
204	    def _clear_hbox_layout(layout: QHBoxLayout) -> None:
205	        """清空横向布局：立即脱离父控件，避免 deleteLater 延迟导致新旧控件叠画。"""
206	        while layout.count():
207	            item = layout.takeAt(0)
208	            w = item.widget()
209	            if w is not None:
210	                w.setParent(None)
211	                w.deleteLater()
212	            sip.delete(item)

214	    def _fill_cost_summary_row_static_zeros(self, layout: QHBoxLayout) -> None:
215	        """第二卡片：无有效汇总数据时，与 Figma 一致展示三块金额，均为 0.00。"""
216	        z = _format_payable_amount(0.0)
217	        for title in ("成本二部", "成本三部"):
218	            cell, lbl = self._cost_stat_cell(f"{title}：")
219	            lbl.setText(z)
220	            layout.addWidget(cell, 1)
221	        tot_w, tot_lbl = self._cost_stat_cell("合计：")
222	        tot_lbl.setText(z)
223	        layout.addWidget(tot_w, 1)
224	
225	    def _fill_cost_summary_row(
226	        self,
227	        layout: QHBoxLayout,
228	        stats,
229	        *,
230	        use_priority_zero: bool,
231	    ) -> None:
232	        """在已清空的 layout 上填充一行（不再清空，由 _refresh_owner_cost_panels 统一清空）。"""
233	        if stats is None:
234	            self._fill_cost_summary_row_static_zeros(layout)
235	            return
236	        amounts = stats.per_owner_zero if use_priority_zero else stats.per_owner_all
237	        total_val = stats.sum_zero if use_priority_zero else stats.sum_all
238	        for title, amt in zip(stats.cost_labels, amounts):
239	            cell, lbl = self._cost_stat_cell(f"{title}：")
240	            lbl.setText(_format_payable_amount(amt))
241	            layout.addWidget(cell, 1)
242	        tot_w, tot_lbl = self._cost_stat_cell("合计：")
243	        tot_lbl.setText(_format_payable_amount(total_val))
244	        layout.addWidget(tot_w, 1)

246	    def _refresh_owner_cost_panels(self, path: str | None) -> None:
247	        """严格按账期 / 本月应付款 两行；path 为 None 时置为 0.00 占位。有总表时由「查看排款」调用以加载汇总。"""
248	        self._clear_hbox_layout(self._lay_strict_cost_row)
249	        self._clear_hbox_layout(self._lay_overall_cost_row)
250	
251	        if (
252	            not path
253	            or not os.path.isfile(path)
254	            or not str(path).lower().endswith(".xlsx")
255	        ):
256	            self._fill_cost_summary_row(
257	                self._lay_strict_cost_row, None, use_priority_zero=True
258	            )
259	            self._fill_cost_summary_row(
260	                self._lay_overall_cost_row, None, use_priority_zero=False
261	            )
262	            return
263	        try:
264	            stats = load_owner_cost_panel_stats(path)
265	        except Exception:
266	            traceback.print_exc()
267	            stats = None
268	        self._fill_cost_summary_row(
269	            self._lay_strict_cost_row, stats, use_priority_zero=True
270	        )
271	        self._fill_cost_summary_row(
272	            self._lay_overall_cost_row, stats, use_priority_zero=False
273	        )

523	    def _rebuild_sheet1_strip_cache(self, path: str | None) -> None:
524	        """从首表 Sheet1 解析五个表头词所在行，横向片段写入 _sheet1_strip_arrays 备用。"""
525	        self._sheet1_strip_row = None
526	        for k in SHEET1_SUMMARY_LABELS:
527	            self._sheet1_strip_arrays[k] = []
528	        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
529	            return
530	        try:
531	            res = read_sheet1_summary_strip(path)
532	            self._sheet1_strip_row = res.row_1based
533	            for k in SHEET1_SUMMARY_LABELS:
534	                self._sheet1_strip_arrays[k] = list(res.columns.get(k, ()))
535	        except Exception:
536	            traceback.print_exc()
537	
538	    def _apply_payable_total_from_sheet(self, path: str | None) -> None:
539	        """Sheet1 第 4 行「排款总额」右侧数字格求和 → 本月可支付总额。"""
540	        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
541	            return
542	        try:
543	            total = sum_sheet1_row4_after_payout_through_total_scheduled(path)
544	        except Exception:
545	            traceback.print_exc()
546	            return
547	        z = _format_payable_amount(0.0)
548	        if total is None:
549	            self.lbl_payable_total_value.setText(z)
550	            self.lbl_reserved_total_value.setText(z)
551	            return
552	        self.lbl_payable_total_value.setText(_format_payable_amount(total))
553	        self.lbl_reserved_total_value.setText(z)
554	
555	    def _on_upload_total(self) -> None:
556	        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
557	            self, "选择排款计划列表", "", EXCEL_FILTER
558	        )
559	        if not path:
560	            return
561	        if not _is_excel_path(path):
562	            QMessageBox.warning(
563	                self, "格式不支持", "请选择 Excel 文件（.xlsx 或 .xls）。"
564	            )
565	            return
566	        d = total_sheet_dir()
567	        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
568	        dest = os.path.join(d, os.path.basename(path))
569	        same_file = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path)) == os.path.normcase(
570	            os.path.abspath(dest)
571	        )
572	        replaced = os.path.isfile(dest) and not same_file
573	        try:
574	            # shutil.copy2：目标已有同名文件时直接覆盖

674	    def _current_bank(self) -> BankOption | None:

134	    ws: Worksheet, min_row: int, max_row: int, min_col: int, max_col: int
135	) -> None:

164	    for r in range(ROW_HEADERS + 1, max_r + 1):
165	        b = _cell_text_normalized(ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value)
166	        f = _cell_text_normalized(ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value)
167	        i = _cell_text_normalized(ws.cell(row=r, column=9).value)
168	        if "编制" not in b:

171	            return r

175	def _ensure_rows_before_footer(
176	    ws: Worksheet, footer_row: int, data_start: int, num_data: int
177	) -> None:
178	    """在表尾行之前保证有 num_data 个连续空行（从 data_start 起），不足则在 footer_row 处向下插入行。"""
179	    if num_data <= 0:
180	        return
181	    gap = footer_row - data_start
182	    if gap < num_data:
183	        ws.insert_rows(footer_row, num_data - gap)

187	    for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
188	        for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):

191	                continue

195	def fill_detail_workbook_from_total(detail_path: str, total_path: str) -> List[str]:
196	    """
197	    打开明细模板与总表，按 Sheet 遍历填充后保存 detail_path。
198	    返回每条人类可读日志（跳过原因等）；无异常则至少返回一条汇总。
199	    """
200	    logs: List[str] = []
201	    wb_a = load_workbook(detail_path, read_only=False, data_only=False)
202	    wb_b = load_workbook(total_path, read_only=False, data_only=True)
203	    try:
204	        ws_b = wb_b.worksheets[0]
205	        b_hdr_to_col = _build_b_header_to_col(ws_b)
206	
207	        for ws_a in wb_a.worksheets:
208	            title = ws_a.title
209	            c_bank = _find_bank_column_for_sheet(ws_b, title)
210	            if c_bank is None:
211	                logs.append(f"跳过 Sheet「{title}」：总表第 3 行未匹配到对应银行列。")
212	                continue
213	
214	            data_rows = _collect_data_rows_bank_numeric(ws_b, c_bank)
215	            a_headers = _build_header_row_map(ws_a, ROW_HEADERS)
216	            if not a_headers:
217	                logs.append(f"跳过 Sheet「{title}」：第 2 行无表头。")
218	                continue
219	
220	            cols_a = sorted(a_headers.keys())
221	            c_min, c_max = min(cols_a), max(cols_a)
222	            serial_cols: List[int] = []
223	            map_ab: Dict[int, Optional[int]] = {}
224	            for ca in cols_a:
225	                hk = _header_map_key(a_headers[ca])
226	                if hk == "序号":
227	                    serial_cols.append(ca)
228	                    map_ab[ca] = None
229	                    continue
230	                cb = b_hdr_to_col.get(hk)
231	                map_ab[ca] = cb
232	
233	            n = len(data_rows)
234	            footer_row = _find_footer_row(ws_a)
235	            if footer_row is None:
236	                logs.append(
237	                    f"「{title}」：未找到表尾「编制」行，仍从第 {ROW_DATA_A} 行起写入（可能覆盖下方内容）。"
238	                )
239	                max_clear_r = max(
240	                    ws_a.max_row or ROW_DATA_A, ROW_DATA_A + n + 50
241	                )
242	                _unmerge_cells_overlapping(
243	                    ws_a, ROW_DATA_A, max_clear_r, c_min, c_max
244	                )
245	                _clear_rectangle(ws_a, ROW_DATA_A, max_clear_r, c_min, c_max)
246	            else:
247	                band_end = footer_row - 1
248	                _unmerge_cells_overlapping(
249	                    ws_a, ROW_DATA_A, max(band_end, ROW_DATA_A), c_min, c_max
250	                )
251	                _clear_rectangle(ws_a, ROW_DATA_A, band_end, c_min, c_max)
252	                _ensure_rows_before_footer(ws_a, footer_row, ROW_DATA_A, n)
253	
254	            for idx, r_b in enumerate(data_rows):
255	                r_a = ROW_DATA_A + idx
256	                for ca in cols_a:
257	                    if ca in serial_cols:
258	                        ws_a.cell(row=r_a, column=ca).value = idx + 1
259	                        continue
260	                    cb = map_ab.get(ca)
261	                    if cb is None:
262	                        continue
263	                    ws_a.cell(row=r_a, column=ca).value = ws_b.cell(
264	                        row=r_b, column=cb
265	                    ).value
266	
267	            if n > 0:
268	                _apply_data_borders(
269	                    ws_a, ROW_DATA_A, ROW_DATA_A + n - 1, c_min, c_max
270	                )
271	
272	            logs.append(
273	                f"「{title}」：银行列第 {c_bank} 列，已写入 {n} 行。"
274	            )
275	
276	        wb_a.save(detail_path)
277	        logs.insert(0, f"排款明细表已生成：{detail_path}")
278	    finally:
279	        wb_b.close()
280	        wb_a.close()
281	
282	    return logs

144	            if not owner:
145	                continue
146	            cell_p = ws1.cell(row=r, column=c_plan)
147	            if isinstance(cell_p, MergedCell):
148	                continue
149	            n = _coerce_numeric_for_sum(cell_p.value)
150	            amt = float(n) if n is not None else 0.0
151	            sum_all[owner] = sum_all.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
152	            if _priority_level_0_2(ws1.cell(row=r, column=c_pri).value) == 0:
153	                sum_zero[owner] = sum_zero.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
154	
155	        cost_labels: List[str] = []
156	        zero_list: List[float] = []
157	        all_list: List[float] = []
158	        for owner, cost_nm in pairs:
159	            label = cost_nm if cost_nm else owner
160	            cost_labels.append(label)
161	            zero_list.append(sum_zero.get(owner, 0.0))
162	            all_list.append(sum_all.get(owner, 0.0))
163	
164	        return OwnerCostPanelStats(
165	            cost_labels=tuple(cost_labels),
166	            per_owner_zero=tuple(zero_list),
167	            per_owner_all=tuple(all_list),
168	            sum_zero=sum(zero_list),
169	            sum_all=sum(all_list),
170	        )
171	    finally:
172	        wb.close()
